title: Ford 1994 4.9L accessory bracket attachment topology
findings: A shared power-steering pump/A/C compressor bracket attaches to both cylinder block and cylinder head.
A separate alternator bracket attaches to the engine; its bottom bolt is distinguished from the remaining attachments.
Alternator pivot, power-steering pump, compressor, Thermactor pump and Thermactor pulley-to-hub fasteners are named separately.
limits: This is attachment architecture evidence, not a dimensioned casting drawing or fastener specification for manufacture.
Bolt counts, hole coordinates, bracket thickness, casting ribs, thread sizes and exact installed bracket part numbers remain unresolved.
Owner photos corroborate accessory presence and broad placement but cannot establish hidden engine attachment datums.
Filtered dealer catalog pages can include 7.3L diesel-only brackets; those bracket part numbers are not accepted for this 4.9L study.
